video_title: Jordan Love vs. Aaron Rodgers in NFL preseason. Throwback I Green Bay Packers I Pittsburgh Steelers

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on the pressure of replacing Aaron Rodgers
quotes.excerpt: There's always nerves that come with it, but I feel that the football is the easy part.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: How do you say, okay, this is how I step in, and do you feel nervous? Do you feel like?

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan Love
text_blocks.text: There's always nerves that come with it, but I feel that the football is the easy part. That's what we do, that's what we're trained to do, and I've been doing that my whole life. But obviously, the part that comes with it, being a first-round draft pick, sitting on the bench for three years, being behind Aaron Rodgers, one of the greatest, and then obviously stepping in and having my opportunity, there's a lot of pressure, a lot of nerves that come with it.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on the fleeting nature of an NFL career
quotes.excerpt: People say all the time, NFL not for long, so you have one shot to do it.
quotes.quote: People say all the time, NFL not for long, so you have one shot to do it and one shot to make the most of it. So I just go out there and have fun with it and don't try and put any added pressure on myself and just enjoy being in this moment and treat every day, put my feet in it and just focus on right now, the present, being in the moment and enjoying it.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on his relationship with Aaron Rodgers
quotes.excerpt: We have a good relationship. Obviously, I was in the quarterback room with him.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: You talked about Aaron Rodgers, and despite all this comparison, you guys probably have a great relationship, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Jordan Love
text_blocks.text: We have a good relationship. Obviously, I was in the quarterback room with him, and when you're in that room together, you're there every day for multiple hours a day, so you build a relationship with everybody that's in that room, the quarterbacks and the quarterback coaches. It's awesome to have that bond.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on the importance of fundamentals for young quarterbacks
quotes.excerpt: Just focus on the fundamentals of footwork, because you see so many guys nowadays trying to master.
quotes.quote: Just focus on the fundamentals of footwork, because you see so many guys nowadays trying to master the cool throws that they see Aaron and Patrick Mahomes doing. It's like, you got to focus on the basics first. Focus on that footwork, on your fundamentals of how you're throwing the ball. Make sure all that's good, and then you can start focus on those cool plays and doing all those crazy things.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on the learning curve from college to the NFL
quotes.excerpt: I learned so much more just about defense and schemes and little things that take your game.
quotes.quote: I learned so much more just about defense and schemes and little things that take your game to the next level. You think in college you got it all figured out, and you get to the NFL and you're like, I learned so much more just about defense and schemes and little things that take your game to the next level.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on the leadership responsibilities of an NFL quarterback
quotes.excerpt: You're the quarterback, you're the voice of the team and you're one of the main leaders.
quotes.quote: You're the quarterback, you're the voice of the team and you're one of the main leaders of the team. That gets thrown at you, you have no say so about that. So just being one of the guys, just enjoying it and having fun.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on his initial experience watching Rodgers and Adams
quotes.excerpt: Getting there, going to training camp and really just being able to see Aaron and Davante.
quotes.quote: Getting there, going to training camp and really just being able to see Aaron and Davante. It was just the connection they had, but just seeing some of the plays they would make, I was like, man, this is cool. You see it on TV, you watch it in the games and then you get there and you see it live and you're like, okay, these dudes are really good.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Love
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Love on organizing off-season workouts with teammates
quotes.excerpt: Throughout that time, usually after OTAs, I'll try and get most of the group of receivers.
quotes.quote: Throughout that time, usually after OTAs, I'll try and get most of the group of receivers, tight ends, running backs, try and get a good amount of those guys out to throw. Throughout the off-season, if guys are staying out here in California, because that's where I do most of my training, I'll hit them up and get out there and do some work together.
